rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for an anatomical artery.

example.english: The doctor pointed to the artery and said it was slightly hardened.
example.traditional: 醫生指住條動脈話有少少硬化。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 zi2 zyu6 tiu4 dung6 mak6 waa6 jau5 siu2 siu2 ngaang6 faa3

rows.note: Use this for a major road, railway line, or other trunk route in a transport network.

example.english: This artery is always congested in the mornings.
example.traditional: 呢條幹線朝早成日塞車。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gon3 sin3 ziu1 zou2 seng4 jat6 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this figuratively for a major route seen as the lifeline of a city or system.

example.english: This railway is the main artery of the whole city.
example.traditional: 呢條鐵路係成個城市嘅大動脈。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tit3 lou6 hai6 seng4 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 daai6 dung6 mak6
